lessons.title: Type checking, tsconfig, and JavaScript output
lessons.intro:
TypeScript with strict checking; ES2022 JavaScript target; runtime output assumes successful type-checking unless the question explicitly asks otherwise. TypeScript checks a program before JavaScript executes. Types and interfaces are normally erased; they do not validate incoming JSON. tsconfig describes the project, including strict checking, target syntax, and library declarations. tsc --noEmit checks a project without writing output. lib makes type declarations available but does not install runtime APIs or polyfills. These lessons assume strict checking and ES2022; additional flags are stated in each question when needed.
